tactics: have key : ∀ l : List {x // p x}, (l.filter f).unattach = l.unattach.filter g := by intro l; induction l with | nil => rfl | cons a l ih => obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := a; by_cases h : g x = true <;> simp_all [List.filter_cons]
by_cases h : g head✝.val = true <;> simp_all
induction tail✝ with | nil => split <;> simp_all | cons a l ih => obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := a; by_cases h : g x = true <;> split <;> simp_all [List.filter_cons]
